Heard learned Senior Counsel Shri A.A.Naik assisted by learned Counsel Shri N.F. Gurnani.

2. In short, it is his contention that Notification issued on 05.10.2021 is contrary to the I st Schedule
of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and
Resettlement Act, 2013.

3.  Accordingly, issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 12.02.2026.
4.

The learned AGP waives service of notice for the respondent nos. 2 to 4/State.
5.

The petitioners are permitted to serve the remaining respondent by private mode, in addition to the regular mode of service and file an affidavit by next date, failing which the petitioners shall deposit costs of Rupees Five Hundred with the High Court Gazetted Officers' Association, Nagpur.
